user: What is the latest Gemini Flash model on OpenRouter and when was it released?

reply.content:
Based on the provided sources, the latest Gemini Flash model on OpenRouter is **Gemini 3.8 Flash** (`google/gemini-3.8-flash`), released on **September 2, 2026** [5]. 

*(Note: OpenRouter also provides an alias endpoint `~google/gemini-flash-latest` pointing to the latest release [1]).*
